subject: ALLOCATE statement
notes: LANDED 2026-08 (PB151), CORRECTED 2026-09-02 (PB152). PB151 wired the fill through and closed the wrong-value half of this rule, but with a decoder PRIVATE to PtrEmitter carrying its own 11.9.10.4 GR5 map - which spelled HIGH-VALUES as U+FFFF while the compiler's one definition of the alphanumeric high value (FigurativeConstants.FillChar, 8.3.3.6.4 GR6) is U+00FF under the native sequence. The extraction routes this arm through the shared InitialStateBackground, so GR8's fill is now the SAME character the data-division background uses; pb152_options_initialize_arm_agreement asks all three arms in one program. GR8/GR9 deliberately key on the CLAUSE and not on its section list - allocated storage belongs to no section - and pb151_options_fill is the characterization pin proving the extraction preserved the landed behaviour (its fill literal was repaired from the nonconforming "Q" to X"51", the same byte).
